as_told.title: 2004 Nimitz Tic Tac picked up by a new FLIR system

plain: In 2004, a new forward-looking infrared camera system, a heat-seeing sensor known as FLIR and made by the defense company Raytheon, had just been installed on the Nimitz carrier strike group, a US Navy aircraft carrier and its escort ships, right before it picked up the object the Navy fighter pilot David Fravor encountered. Michels tells this himself in three episodes, including a debate with the skeptic Mick West, and the story holds that Raytheon later distanced itself from what its system caught. Only his first telling touches on that point, and the others just stress the timing of the brand new sensor.
